title: Builds an environment-driven Node configuration module and CLI
prompt: Create only src/config.js and bin/show-config.js. Export readConfig(env = process.env) from src/config.js. It must return { port, mode, label }: port is a base-10 integer from PORT when it is between 1 and 65535, otherwise 3000; mode is MODE only when it is dev, test, or prod, otherwise dev; label is trimmed APP_LABEL when nonempty, otherwise Claudette. The CLI must print exactly label|mode|port plus one newline. Run node verify.mjs. Do not modify package.json or verify.mjs. When verification passes, reply with exactly ENV_MATRIX_OK.
